market: Global Adhesion Promoters and Primers Market
market_definition: Adhesion Promoters and Primers comprises liquid or other pre-treatment products applied to substrates to improve adhesive or sealant adhesion, support durability and enhance interface performance. Products marketed for bonding and sealing preparation are included. By Chemistry • Silane-Based • Silane-Modified Polymer • Solvent-Based Primers • Water-Based Primers • Reactive Primers By Substrate • Metal • Glass • Plastics • Elastomers • Composites By Form • Liquid • Aerosol • Wipe-On By Function • Adhesion Promotion • Corrosion Protection at Bond Line • Sealant Priming • Difficult-Substrate Bonding By End Use • Automotive • Construction • Electronics • Aerospace • Industrial Assembly By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Paint primers and coating primers without bonding or sealant adhesion function, surface cleaners, adhesives, and complete surface-treatment equipment. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies.
